summary: SentinelOne urges the FCC to keep Managed Internal Broadband Services (MIBS) and advanced firewall/endpoint security services eligible for E‑Rate, and to add a new category for AI security monitoring tools. SentinelOne argues that the FCC should preserve Managed Internal Broadband Services (MIBS) and expand E‑Rate eligibility to include AI tools that meet existing governance and security requirements. SentinelOne, a cybersecurity vendor, argues that Managed Internal Broadband Services (MIBS) should be preserved and expanded to include managed cybersecurity monitoring, citing the need for reliable network operation and referencing the FCC’s pilot program. SentinelOne argues that modern endpoint detection and response platforms should be recognized as eligible firewall services under the E‑Rate ESL. SentinelOne advocates expanding E‑Rate eligibility to include cloud‑delivered versions of existing services and AI security monitoring tools that support school broadband networks. SentinelOne proposes adding AI security monitoring and governance to the E‑Rate eligible services, while also requesting clarification on existing cybersecurity services.
